title: Refunds
answer: Late or damaged parcels qualify for a full refund within 30 days of the delivery date.

title: Change the delivery address
answer: You can change the delivery address in the app until the parcel is dispatched.

title: Password reset
answer: Use 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page. ParcelPal staff will never ask for your password.

title: Damage claims
answer: Photograph the box and the label, then file a claim in the app within 7 days.

title: Batteries
answer: Lithium batteries cannot travel by air. Ground shipping is allowed with a hazard label.

title: Knives and tools
answer: Kitchen knives may be shipped if sheathed and boxed; the recipient shows ID (18+) at delivery.

title: Stolen or missing parcels
answer: Report a missing or stolen parcel within 48 hours and we will open a trace.

title: Parcel kiosk troubleshooting
answer: If the parcel-kiosk app freezes, staff can end the stuck process (for example kill <pid> on the Linux kiosk) and restart the app.

title: Contact support
answer: Write to support@parcelpal.example or use the in-app chat.

title: Delivery hours
answer: We deliver 08:00-20:00 Monday to Saturday. There are no Sunday deliveries.

title: Returns
answer: Print the prepaid self-addressed return label from your order page and drop the parcel at any ParcelPal point.

title: Notifications
answer: Turn off marketing emails under Settings > Notifications.

title: Tracking
answer: Your tracking number is in the confirmation message and on the order page.
